question.prompt: The number halfway between \(\dfrac{1}{6}\) and \(\dfrac{1}{4}\) is

solutions.explanation:
The number halfway between two numbers is their average. To find it, add the endpoints and divide by \(2\). Using a common denominator first gives
\[
\frac16+\frac14=\frac2{12}+\frac3{12}=\frac5{12}.
\]
Dividing this sum by \(2\), we obtain
\[
\frac5{12}\div2=\frac5{12}\times\frac12=\boxed{\frac5{24}}.
\]
This is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
solutions.title: Average the two endpoints
